published_applications.statement_used: Kernel characterization for the full law and factorization through a surjective algebra quotient.
hypotheses_checked: D is the original multiplicative homogeneous full GDet, not its trace.
Coefficient ring is commutative and the group algebra is associative unital.
Every scalar-extended group-algebra map is surjective; its kernel is generated by killed elements.
No reducedness, field, residual irreducibility or n! invertibility premise.
published_applications.checked_in: proell_descent/main.tex PQL7; subsequent applications as listed

published_applications.citation: Chenevier, The p-adic analytic space of pseudocharacters of a profinite group and pseudorepresentations over arbitrary rings
published_applications.statement_used: The generic coefficient Cayley-Hamilton ideal is contained in the full determinant kernel.
hypotheses_checked: Original CH is precisely coefficients of characteristic identities for generic finite tuples.
All commutative scalar algebras are retained; rank positive on every actual Pt.
Rank-zero case is the constant-one law, treated directly.
published_applications.checked_in: proell_descent/main.tex PQL7; subsequent applications as listed

published_applications.citation: Chenevier, The p-adic analytic space of pseudocharacters of a profinite group and pseudorepresentations over arbitrary rings
published_applications.statement_used: A continuous discrete-valued determinant on a profinite group kills an open normal subgroup's augmentation ideal.
hypotheses_checked: The group is the original compact totally disconnected Hausdorff plus subgroup.
The coefficient ring B/I^a has the discrete topology.
Original IsCont makes each characteristic coefficient locally constant modulo I^a.
No finite coefficient-ring or finitely generated group hypothesis is used.
